Privileged Access Request For Resource & Design Center Declined
Dear {!PRM_Registration_Request__c.PRM_First_Name__c} {!PRM_Registration_Request__c.PRM_Last_Name__c},
We appreciate your interest in the Resource & Design Center, however, upon review of your application we regret to inform you that your request for a Privileged account to the Resource & Design Center has been declined. Some reasons for denial may include:
Application does not meet the Privileged Program criteria. The request for Privileged access does not allow for the use of personal emails. The request needs to be submitted with your company's e-mail address. Privileged access to the Resource & Design Center requires a Corporate Non-Disclosure Agreement (CNDA) between your company and Intel®.
You may continue to use your login to access the site's public content and special offers. If you feel your request was denied in error, please contact account assistance via phone or email for more information.
Please DO NOT reply to this e-mail message. This is an automated response. To ensure that you continue receiving your e-mails, please add us to your address book.
Kind Regards, RDC Privilege Team
